description: r63 (PLAN A7 (c), B200 screen, step-capped): r60's config (A 006's recipe on the longer cosine schedule, keep_best_dev) with 96 prompts per step instead of 64, and the schedule shortened to keep the prompts seen the same: cosine over 583 steps, stopped at 467 (467 x 96 = 44,832, against r60's 700 x 64 = 44,800).
